Youthnic Native Android Return Scanner · Release v1.0.26
- Fixed in-app update crash on 'Install Now' by adding FileProvider external storage roots and exception handling
- Amazon Order ID scanning & manual lookup support (hyphenated 408-XXXXXXX-XXXXXXX and numeric 17-digit IDs)

- Launcher icon: Official Youthnic white cursive 'Y' monogram rendered on all device launchers
- Pre-OMSGuru unmapped SKU warning alerts and CSV workflow support
